message.Title: Generally Available: Mirroring in Fabric for PostgreSQL Flexible Server

Body.Content:
You can now bring data together and simplify analytics using Microsoft Fabric mirroring for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, now generally available. Mirroring in Fabric unifies your organizational data in OneLake and supports network-isolated servers (using virtual networks or private endpoints) and highly available configurations. To enhance app integration with rich business insights, you can join data across various sources and enjoy one-click integration with Microsoft Power BI. For swift, efficient access, you can optimize your data using the Delta Lake table features. 

Learn more.
